metaTitle: About Greeley Solar Reset | Solar Detach and Reset Experts in Greeley and Northern Colorado
metaDescription: Greeley Solar Reset handles solar detach and reset for reroofs and hail damage across Weld and Larimer counties. Licensed and insured, free written estimates.
heroSub: We take solar panels off, protect them while your roofer works, and put them back exactly where they belong. That's the whole job, and we do it well.
storyHtml:
Greeley Solar Reset started with a problem we kept seeing all over Northern Colorado. A hailstorm rolls through, a homeowner gets a new roof approved, and then the roofer says the same thing every roofer says: we don't touch solar panels. Suddenly the whole project stalls while everyone figures out who handles the array.

So that's what we do. Solar detach and reset is our only trade, not a side service bolted onto something else. We remove your panels, label and store them safely, coordinate with your roofing crew, and reinstall everything once the new roof is on. We test the system before we leave so you know it's producing like it should.

Because most of our work comes out of hail season, we've learned how insurance claims actually move around here. We know what adjusters look for, how detach and reset shows up in a scope, and when a supplement makes sense. We're not adjusters and we won't pretend to be, but we document our work thoroughly and we'll walk you through what the work really costs so nothing in your claim is a guess.

We're based in Greeley and we work across Weld and Larimer counties, from Evans and Eaton up through Windsor and down to Firestone and Fort Lupton. Every estimate is free and in writing, we're licensed and insured, and our emergency line answers around the clock when a storm tears something loose.

values.title: Written estimates, no surprises
values.desc: You get a free written estimate before we touch a panel. The number you approve is the number you pay unless the scope genuinely changes, and if it does, we explain why first.

values.title: Your schedule is the schedule
values.desc: A reroof can't move until the panels do. We show up when we say we will, on the detach and on the reset, because your whole project is waiting on us.

values.title: Careful hands, careful records
values.desc: Panels, rails, and wiring get labeled, photographed, and stored properly. That protects your equipment, and it gives your adjuster clean documentation if there's a claim involved.

values.title: Local and accountable
values.desc: We live and work in Northern Colorado. If something isn't right after your reset, you call us and we come back. That's how it should work with a local company.

faq.q: Are you connected to my original solar installer?
faq.a: No, we're an independent detach and reset company. That matters because many installers are booked out for weeks on removal work or charge a premium for it. We work on most residential rooftop systems regardless of who installed them, and if we find something we can't service, we'll tell you up front.

faq.q: Do you work directly with my roofer and my insurance adjuster?
faq.a: Yes, and it usually makes the whole reroof smoother. We coordinate timing with your roofing crew so the panels are off before tear-off day, and we provide the documentation and line items adjusters expect. You can read more about how pricing works on our removal and reinstall cost page.

faq.q: What if the hail damaged my panels, not just my roof?
faq.a: We inspect every panel during the detach and flag anything that looks compromised, with photos, so damaged equipment can be added to your claim instead of going back on a brand new roof. Our solar hail damage page covers what we look for and what your options are.
